notes.title: One last final update
notes.notes:
I had some spare time so I tried porting Twwwr to a newer version of gamemaker and fixing some bugs. I think it was successful, though it's difficult for me to track down all the bugs on my own. Anyways for list of changes:

Fixed some game crashes
Improved camera
Remade controller-bindings to be more flexible
Fixed typos
Fixed some ui issues
Reprogrammed some enemy attacks to be more consistent
Lots of other small tweaks

I was considering adding some actual new content to the game but the project is so poorly programmed I don't really want to touch it again. I'll keep my eye on the steam discussions in the coming days in case any new issues crop up.

That's all, thanks for reading and have a nice day.

notes.title: Small summer sale update
notes.notes:
Thank you all for the continued support. I've fixed a few bugs and made some changes:
[olist]
Getting second charge level doesn't break acid flower anymore
Expert forest spirit is easier
There's now an icon in the pause menu to check if your current run is pacifist. Heart icon means your eligible for pacifist, skull means you're not.
Sunflower soles now also makes you un-pushable, to help you not getting blocked by enemies
Fixed some room collisions
Lots of small tweeks
[/olist]

notes.title: Final update
notes.notes:
Final update is out. Here's a list of the major Changes:

Lilly sidequest:
Talking to Lilly throughout the game now lets you do a small quest. A golden Passiflora Is hiding somewhere around the temple.

https://i.imgur.com/67gjswS.png

New Area:
There's now a door in layer 1 that lets you access a new area. however it's locked, so you'll need to get the key from someone.

https://i.imgur.com/QA4xrrc.png

New aim options:
If you're using the controller, you can now aim with the c-stick. If you're using keyboard, using the mouse Is also an option.

https://i.imgur.com/F4whVXR.gif

High contrast Enemies
There was an issue with the game being hard to read. I wasn't able to come up with a good solution, but maybe this extra option helps a little.

https://i.imgur.com/U3a6BzK.gif

notes.title: 1.0.2 update(auto-aim fix, music and balance )
notes.notes:
Changelog:

Auto-aim
It turns out I wrote the auto-aim code wrong, So it only checked the nearest enemy/object. This made it so standing close to a box while aiming would result in the auto-aim just not working. I've rewritten the code so it works much better now. The auto-aim is now a bit more strict, but since it's bug free it evens out.

Balance:

 bosses have about 8% more hp(67>72)(boss hp was too low before, better auto aim as well means bosses should be tougher)
 
 nerfed poison trinket(0.008 > 0.006)
 nefred long range(2.15 > 1.9)
 nerfed begonia trigger
 base gun range increased(6.9 > 7)


Music:

 Layer 02 now has different music
 Layer 03 boss now has different music
 All 3 layer 02 fights now have different songs
 tweaked all the music volume


bugs

 signs/doors don't soflock the game
 added some missing walls
 fixed sound in some areas
 fixed some collision


More is on the way
https://i.imgur.com/RaC37rb.png

notes.title: Post launch Patch 1/Thank you.
notes.notes:
1.0.1 hotfix 

Thank you to everyone for the support. I've taken the time to start reading some feedback, and I'm trying to address it as quickly as possible. I haven't started reading reviews yet since it's a bit overwhelming, But I'll try to do so soon. Afterwards I might start adding more content to make the experience more fulfilling. I imagine some more story could go a long way.

-faxdoc

 Changes 

 small warning 
Due to a small error on my part, updating the game will cause a couple of bosses to respawn if you load an pre-patch savefile. It's not game breaking in any way, and you can just warp past them If you don't feel like fighting them.

 general 

Added dualshock support


 balance 

Fungus chambers is a tiny bit weaker
Begonia trigger is a tiny bit weaker


  polish 

Jump/shoot extra works on everything
Space/enter works in menues
Added wood sound to wood flooring
Pressing a button while trinket text is spelling out completes the text rather than skipping it


 bug fixes  

Fixed sound playing some places it should/shouldn't
Fixed sound in temple area
Teleporting from layer 3 to layer 5 doesn't make layer 5 dark
Ending text bug fixed
Ending credits end a bit earlier
You can now get the "scared" achievement
Fixed first boss sometimes crashing the game(at least I think so, the bug is super rare)
You can no longer use crates to teleport out of bounce in the first stage
